description: Election Commission - Mr. N. Vimalendran as a member of Kandy M/C - Mr. D. G. Tyurin as a member of the Rajgama P/S - Mr. U. S. M. M. Hussain member of the Akurana P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kandy Municipal Council, Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha, and Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, specifically the replacement of elected members who have vacated their seats due to cessation of party membership or death, which falls under election-related matters rather than government personnel appointments or structural changes.
